snippet.title: This Skill Makes You Dangerous In The AI Era
snippet.description:
Subscribe to my newsletter → https://www.sandeepswadia.com/newsletter

Most people think AI is making us less intelligent.

Ironically, AI isn't the real problem.

The real danger is losing the ability to think critically in a world where deepfakes, AI-generated content, misinformation, and persuasive marketing make it harder than ever to separate truth from fiction.

In this episode, I break down the five distortions that quietly hijack your judgment every day—and the practical mental tools you can use to think more clearly, make better decisions, and avoid being manipulated in the age of AI.

You'll learn how to:

• Recognize when authority is replacing evidence
• Spot marketing spin designed to influence your decisions
• Escape groupthink and challenge popular consensus
• Use ChatGPT and other AI tools without becoming dependent on them
• Detect AI hallucinations and verify AI-generated information
• Ask better questions that uncover what's actually true
• Make AI your research assistant instead of your replacement
• Identify the stories you're telling yourself that distort reality
• Strengthen your judgment in a world of misinformation and deepfakes
• Develop critical thinking skills that become more valuable as AI becomes more powerful

I also share lessons from Theranos, the $25 million AI deepfake scam, psychology experiments on conformity, marketing tactics used by the world's biggest companies, and practical frameworks for using AI without surrendering your ability to think.

Most importantly, you'll learn that the future won't belong to the people with the most powerful AI tools.

It will belong to the people with the strongest judgment.

Because in a world where anyone can generate convincing answers...

The ultimate competitive advantage is knowing what to believe.
